answer: In a decentralized AI network, the Yarrow secret sharing scheme can effectively resist Sybil attacks by dividing a shared resource into shards, each requiring a unique subset of agents to collaborate. This approach, analogous to a lagoon where each agent must navigate a distinct spiral path to access the shared resource, ensures that an attacker cannot control the majority without compromising the entire system, thereby mitigating fake-identity attacks and maintaining network integrity.
